sa: सर्वं ह्येतद् ब्रह्मायमात्मा ब्रह्म सोऽयमात्मा चतुष्पात् ॥ २॥
iast: sarvaṃ hyetad brahmāyamātmā brahma so’yamātmā catuṣpāt ॥ 2॥

alt.text: All this Universe is the Eternal Brahman, this Self is the Eternal, and the Self is fourfold.

tr.text: All this is certainly Brahman. This Self is Brahman. This Self, as such, is possessed of four quarters.

takeaway: All this is Brahman, and this Self is Brahman: what you are and what everything is are not two.
